newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: IMF officials to meet Argentine minister Friday.
newsitem.headline: IMF officials to meet Argentine minister Friday.

text.p: Officials from the International Monetary Fund will meet with Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez this week, state news agency Telam reported on Tuesday, citing ministry officials.
Claudio Losser, the IMF head of the Western Hemisphere and economist Teresa Terminassian will meet with Fernandez Friday in a routine meeting, Telam said.

Last week the IMF approved a disbursement of $148 million under a stand-by agreement with Argentina. It was the fifth disbursement under the agreement, raising Argentina's total outstanding debt with the organization to $6.21 billion.

Argentina's current stand-by accord with the IMF, which ends this year, includes a fiscal deficit target of $3 billion for 1997. Argentina met the first quarter target with a deficit of $1.04 billion.
The country is currently negotiating a three-year Extended Fund Facility to kick in when the stand-by agreement ends.
